hebrewText: וּ/מִן הַ/גָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל דָּוִיד֩ לַ/מְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָ/ה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָ/רֹ֑מַח וּ/פְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/כִ/צְבָאיִ֥ם עַל הֶ/הָרִ֖ים לְ/מַהֵֽר

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: a Gadite (collectively) or descendants of Gad
tokens.kjv: Gadites, children of Gad.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.explanation: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.explanationEn: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad

tokens.bdb: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
tokens.kjv: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.
tokens.enLiteralWord: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively
tokens.explanation: badal — separar, dividir, distinguir entre duas coisas
tokens.explanationEn: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.kjv: David.
tokens.explanation: David — Davi, rei de Israel, autor de muitos salmos

tokens.bdb: a fastness (as a covert of ambush)
tokens.kjv: castle, fort, (strong) hold, munition.
tokens.explanation: a fastness

tokens.bdb: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
tokens.kjv: desert, south, speech, wilderness.
tokens.explanation: a pasture (i.e. open field

tokens.bdb: powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant
tokens.kjv: champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.
tokens.explanation: powerful; by implication

tokens.bdb: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
tokens.kjv: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).
tokens.explanation: probably a force

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
tokens.kjv: appointed time, ([phrase]) army, ([phrase]) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).
tokens.explanation: a mass of persons (or figuratively

tokens.bdb: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
tokens.kjv: battle, fight(-ing), war(-rior).
tokens.explanation: a battle ; generally

tokens.bdb: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.
tokens.explanation: to set in a row

tokens.bdb: a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing)
tokens.kjv: buckler, cold, hook, shield, target.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a hook ; also a  shield ; also cold
tokens.enLiteralWord: a hook ; also a  shield ; also cold
tokens.explanation: a hook ; also a  shield ; also cold
tokens.explanationEn: a hook ; also a  shield ; also cold

tokens.bdb: a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point
tokens.kjv: buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a lance ; especially the iron point
tokens.enLiteralWord: a lance ; especially the iron point
tokens.explanation: a lance ; especially the iron point
tokens.explanationEn: a lance ; especially the iron point

tokens.kjv: (young) lion, [phrase] pierce (from the margin).
tokens.explanation: a lion

tokens.bdb: splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful)
tokens.kjv: beautiful(-ty), glorious (-ry), goodly, pleasant, roe(-buck).
tokens.explanation: splendor ; also a gazelle

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.kjv: hill (country), mount(-ain), [idiom] promotion.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly
tokens.kjv: be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) [idiom] quickly, rash, [idiom] shortly, (be so) [idiom] soon, make speed, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] straightway, [idiom] suddenly, swift.
tokens.explanation: properly
